question.text: Two mirrors at an angle $\theta^{\circ}$ produce 5 images of a point. The number of images produced when $\theta$ is decreased to $\theta^{\circ}-30^{\circ}$ is

solution.text:
Hints: No. of images $=5$
$\therefore \theta=60^{\circ}$
New angle $=\theta-30^{\circ}=30^{\circ}$. No of images $=\frac{360^{\circ}}{30^{\circ}}-1=11$
